ABOUT_ME.TITLE_INTRO_DESC: Hi, my name is Danil Moskalenko. I’m a Full Stack Web Developer with 2 years of professional experience. I'm specializing in building modern web applications from designing the backend architecture to making sure a div is perfectly centered. I have built and deployed many features that is used by many customers every day and seeing other people using things i have build inspire me to keep improving and providing even better solutions.

APPLICATIONS.GROCERY_APP_DESC: I built a mobile-first grocery app with React, CSS, and Firebase, which I developed for personal use. It installs directly on a phone’s home screen and feels like a native app. The app offers secure login, real-time syncing, multi-language item support, and shared lists, all with smooth performance and an intuitive interface.
APPLICATIONS.PERSONAL_WEBSITE_DESC: You're currently browsing it :) This project was a full redesign of my previous site, created to challenge and refine my front-end skills. Built from scratch using React and pure CSS. The custom design was created by my girlfriend, a graphic designer who kindly helped out. Thanks for stopping by!

PHOTOGRAPHY.GENERAL_DESC_HAWAII: My photography is a way of capturing the mood and rhythm of places I’ve lived and loved. In Hawaii, I focused on natural light, vivid colors, and the calm energy of the ocean and landscapes.
PHOTOGRAPHY.GENERAL_DESC_MTL: Exploring the city’s streets, I focus on calm, raw moments—quiet corners, shadowed alleys, and everyday scenes with a moody, dark-toned aesthetic. My work captures the stillness behind the movement, the grit behind the charm. This is Montreal, stripped down and real.
PHOTOGRAPHY.GENERAL_DESC_NYC: I captured the city in vertical frames, focusing on the most striking moments I experienced. From towering buildings to fleeting street scenes, each shot reflects what truly stood out to me.
